hero.h1: Ifrane & Middle Atlas Cedar Forest Day Trip
hero.lead: Fes → Ifrane → Azrou Cedar Forest → Barbary Macaques → Fes

paras: Nicknamed the "Switzerland of Morocco," Ifrane is a world away from the Fes medina — sloped roofs, pine-lined streets, and cool mountain air year-round. The route continues into the Middle Atlas cedar forests near Azrou, home to wild Barbary macaques.
A shorter, lower-cost route than our other Fes day trips, and an easy pick for nature lovers or anyone wanting a change of scenery from the imperial cities.
chips: 🚗 ≈145 km round trip · about 2.5 hrs driving

includes: Guided stops in Ifrane and the cedar forest

good.h2: Pack a layer, even in summer
paras: Ifrane sits at altitude and stays noticeably cooler than Fes year-round — bring a light jacket even if it's hot in the city.
Booking terms: Send an enquiry first; we confirm the departure time, final price, and pickup details by email. No payment is taken through this website.

items.a: Sightings of Barbary macaques near Azrou are common but not guaranteed, since they're wild animals moving through the forest.

items.q: Is this trip suitable in winter?
items.a: Yes, though Ifrane occasionally sees snow in winter — a novelty for many visitors, but dress warmly and expect possible route delays after heavy snowfall.

items.q: How is this different from the other Fes day trips?
items.a: It's our nature-focused route — shorter and lower-cost than Chefchaouen, and a good complement to the history-focused Meknes & Volubilis trip.
